newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN GETS VIP PROTECTION AFTER THREATS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AZHARUDDIN GETS VIP PROTECTION AFTER THREATS.

text.p: Mohammed Azharuddin has been given government protection
normally reserved for VIPs after receiving undefined threats
Azharuddin, playing for India in the first test against
South Africa which began on Wednesday, has received
threatening telephone calls from Moslem fundamentalists groups
angered by his marriage last week to Hindu actress Sangeeta
Moslem Azharuddin is a divorcee and has two
Six armed men from the government's Special Protection
Group, that normally protects high-risk politicians, are
protecting Azharuddin and his wife in this western Indian city.
